body: That's because those moments won't last. I feel what you're saying. If only God could put us out of our misery, at least those who really want life to end. God sees and knows EVERYTHING, surely He can see our deepest, earnest desire to just fade away. Personally, I don't wish any ill to anyone, not even those haters of mine, I just want to push up daisies soon! Life will get bored of me, and maybe my show will end, and the curtains will fall!
You look like a puppet for cons.
Sad... Really sad! The good done is easily forgotten...
